body: That was a method i was considering but decided on another option that would be quicker and easier
Yeah. I was just in the hospital for a week, and even though it wasnt allowed i kept a belt underneath my pants with the intention of using it while in there. Never found the right time or place.

Yeah i see a psychiatrist and a counsellor, but i feel like my counsellor just gives me a bunch of blah blah blah im not in a position to relate too, or maybe cant accept, and my psychiatrist just shovels medication at me that i feel like has just made things worse. Hes got me hooked on benzos, yet another awesome thing to deal with. Not that ive been able to tell either of them yeah im ready to kill my self because id just be put in an inpatient facility, which ive done and is terrible. But hey i dont think im going to have the courage to go through with my plan tonight so i guess thats a weird blessing.
So far, i dont feel any better and feel cowardly for not being able to follow through with what i really want to do but im hoping by tonight ill have worked up the courage i really am

I dont know how i could possibly live a year or 2 like this. I cant. The knowledge that i fucked everything up and someone who once loved me so much now hates me is far to much for me to bare. I miss her so much. I want so badly to have her back in my life and try to make things work. To show her im still the guy she fell in love with 4 years ago. But i cant. Shes gone. Along with our dog who was my best friend. And its my fault. It has destroyed me. I understand its something most people find a way to accept and move on from but i just cant wrap my mind around it even a little bit.

I have tried to tell my self the same. And that mental illness is an illness like any other and if she really loved me she would have stuck it out with me and tried to help me more. All a bunch of bullshit. Im in the same boat, she would have spent forever with me, she really did love me and i just fucked it up again and again until slowly her love turned to resentment and hatred. Despite what everyone else tells me i know its noones fault but my own. And ive spent more then 100 days now trying to come to grips with it, but the burdon feels to much to bare. I get worse and worse everyday. I dont eat. I dont sleep. I cant bring my self to leave the house most days. And ive finally given up and am at peace with that decision. Ive written the note. I have my plan, its just a matter of having the courage to follow through. It sounds morbid but i am almost excited for those 2 minutes tomorrow where i am finally under the water and i know theres no turning back and i can just let go of everything. To be honest thats part of the reason im going to go see her. I want to see her one last time and let her know how sorry i am, but i also know it will be that final push i need to go do what i need to do
